column1: # ForgeKey production OTA partition table for 8 MB parts (XIAO ESP32-S3)
# with encrypted NVS storage. Same layout and semantics as
# data partition — but the slots are grown to 3 MB because the 4 MB table's
# 1.5 MB slot cannot hold the camera + TFLite people-counter image (~2.24 MB).
# The 4 MB table stays the default: the ESP32-C3 prod targets (epaper
# relay) only have 4 MB of flash and cannot use this one. Keep the two files in
# step when adding or renaming a partition.
